entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese home-center broom context and all twelve full sets. Verified outdoor balcony drain sand, separate dustpan, eighty-centimeter storage height, display telescopic lock test, combined thickness versus cupboard depth and final two-item choice.

Read Japanese fish-port sorting context and all twelve full sets. Verified second wet label unreadable lower half, hold in original second position not on cart, fish type insufficient for destination, player offers transport-worker notice then sorts readable boxes. Clarified Burmese offer actor.

Read Japanese appliance-store context and all twelve full sets. Verified fifty-centimeter width insufficient with manual heat clearance, window-side alternative may hit desk, open-door dimensions and cord reach checked, no purchase until remeasured. Clarified Traditional Chinese remeasurement verb.

Read Japanese pre-ticket-gate context and all twelve full sets. Verified printed destination one station short, not yet entered, no duplicate purchase before desk consultation, fare difference check and correct station written, current ticket retained for possible change.

Read Japanese station lost-property context and all twelve full sets. Verified blue pouch after disembarking, nine-ish arrival and rear carriage rack, company envelope without own name, no matching find yet, phone contact and work delay notice before collection guidance.

Read Japanese cooking-class context and all twelve full sets. Verified yesterday index-finger cut, no forced knife or food handling, partner cuts and handles hot pots, reading quantities and sequence after watching demo, cleanup tasks keeping injured hand dry. Corrected Tagalog instructor/pair role and Thai ingredient noun.

Read Japanese postal move-notification context and all twelve full sets. Verified only player moves, roommate stays, full old address, new room number forgotten not guessed, unfinished form taken home with guide and only own name before return.

Read Japanese food-factory packaging context and all twelve full sets. Verified torn right glove touched last three bags, separate inspection tray rather than shipping, supervisor decides product handling, change away from product and no return of isolated bags after handwashing. Clarified glove rather than finger holes in eleven locales.

Read Japanese temple collection context and all twelve full sets. Verified lost claim tag, two blue covers insufficient, pencil surname inside back cover, discreet Nguyen confirmation without other visitors pages, wait without touching until ink dries. Clarified Burmese received inscription and Chinese spoken address.

Read Japanese takeaway-sushi order context and all twelve full sets. Verified Lin original five-thirty delayed by work, six-thirty confirmed, two nigiri portions unchanged, call as soon as further delay known and direct return to accommodation. Naturalized Chinese address.

Read Japanese highway-bus stop context and all twelve full sets. Verified Osaka destination alone insufficient, reserved14:20 not current service, no early change, wait at same stop with bag until correct service attendant and recheck before boarding.

Read Japanese zoo entrance/exit context and all twelve full sets. Verified unspecified exit and unanswered ringing phone, adult male green jacket white hat, player stays by entrance information board and messages, reply locates other exit then friend comes over. Corrected Bengali staff inquiry action.

Read Japanese convenience-store printer context and all twelve full sets. Verified tomorrow interview document, original two pages combined one sheet caused small text, settings-only help without reading contents, separate page printing with price check, readable result and paper/session closure.

Read Japanese tax-inquiry context and all twelve full sets. Verified employer-addressed envelope and body without own name, not assumed personal tax bill, ask workplace why given, separate own prior-year withholding statement and personal filing advice.

Read Japanese trailhead context and all twelve full sets. Verified two hours before return bus with no breaks in map timing, both first-time walkers, no rushing, unreachable companion waited for at fixed bench, reunited then cancel mountain entry and go bus stop.

Read Japanese work-jacket shop context and all twelve full sets. Verified lifting goods requires free arms, cuffs first too long, second fit and back movement checked, wash label versus workplace laundry net, trial/purchase sizes matched and navy one jacket. Clarified Burmese indoors versus underwear.

Read Japanese self-service udon context and all twelve full sets. Verified before eating hot intended but cold receipt/order possible self-selection error, bowl left to avoid spill, kitchen approves replacement, additional fee asked then none, correct hot bowl eaten in place.

Read Japanese police-box lost-cloth-bag context and all twelve full sets. Verified blue bag absent on station-to-shopping-street walk, last station bench, white-thread name on handle, work gloves and red company notebook but no wallet/keys, callback during work and separate station inquiry.

Read Japanese wet orchard context and all twelve full sets. Verified mud-packed boots no slope, lower plot pending supervisor inspection, empty harvest boxes under roof, old variety label kept pending check, two wet-bottom boxes apart from dry and wait for call. Clarified Burmese dry-versus-six ambiguity.

Read Japanese witness-correction context and all twelve full sets. Verified prior red jacket now uncertain from nearby red sign, no new evidence, yesterday3pm and recorded staff name, direction retained, narrow certainty correction without invented replacement color.

Checked unopened envelope dialogue: matching room address never establishes ownership, unknown former resident remains unknown, no recipient rewriting or opening, discovery yesterday and separate handling retained across all twelve locales.

Checked bank queue dialogue: consultation ticket twenty differs from deposit/withdrawal thirty-one, current consultation eighteen and right-hand display retained; account consultation remains distinct from cash withdrawal across all twelve locales.
